Thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation I scheduled a 45-minute live demo for next Thursday (Jun 12) to walk through:
- inference latency and cost tradeoffs for your triage workflows
- Dedicated vs hosted routing options for compliance needs
- a short roadmap for pilot -> production rollout and next steps (SOW attached)

Hi Aisha,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the materials — the SOC2 doc looks good at a glance. Unfortunately we need to pause the live demo next week. Two things came up: 1) leadership just redirected our Q2 engineering sprint toward a cross-platform analytics migration (resource-heavy), and 2) our two primary stakeholders (me and Tom) will be traveling the week of Jun 9–16.

Given that combination, we’re deprioritizing new inference pilots for the quarter. We don’t want to lose the conversation entirely — can you put Meridian on a short standby? If possible, we’d like a brief note in September to reassess timing (likely early Q4).

If you’re open to it, we’d happily accept a short recorded overview of the demo (20–25 min) or a 30-minute technical sync with an SE that we can book once stakeholders are back. For now, please cancel the Jun 12 meeting and keep the SOW & SOC2 in our file.

Thanks again — Samantha
Director, Data Platforms | Meridian Health
